summary.content:
Today's selection covers 52 articles from 7 trusted sources, including 28 on Artificial Intelligence and 10 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: Man charged with attempted murder over attack on home of OpenAI's Sam Altman
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Anthropic, Microsoft
• **Security Alert**: Nightclub Giant RCI Hospitality Reports Data Breach
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights phishing, data breaches, malware
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from BBC Technology, NY Times Tech, Dark Reading, The Verge, BleepingComputer and others
• **Fresh Content**: 35 articles published in the last 24 hours
